items.note: The teal settings band is above an outlined profile card. A red-bordered summary at the top says 'Fix the 2 fields marked below, then save again'. The email input has a red border and an icon-plus-text message. The focused, empty full-name field shows only the pink halo, so its red error border is gone. The pink save button and ghost reset sit in the save row.

Same layout on a black ground with a dark raised card. The red summary box and both inline messages (warning icon plus a sentence) read clearly. The focused full-name field again swaps its red error border for the pink halo. Ink text on the teal band passes contrast.

One-column form under a collapsed band and a pill strip with the ink 'Profile' pill. The error summary wraps cleanly and each field's message sits under its input. The focused full-name field shows the pink halo instead of the red error border. The save and reset buttons are side by side at full width.

The form is filled and valid. A 'Saved' box with a pink check icon, an ink border and a hard offset shadow appears in the save row next to the save and reset buttons. It is the same size and shape as a button, so it reads like a lifted button, not a confirmation.
Dark version of the same inline 'Saved' box with a light hard shadow. It is legible. As in light mode, it sits in line with the buttons and has a button's shape, not a bottom-left toast.
The 'Saved' box spans the full width under the save and reset buttons, with a check icon and the hard shadow. The message is clear, but it is shaped like a third button in the action row.

A raised dialog with an ink border, a hard shadow.lg, a regular-weight title, one sentence of consequence, a ghost Cancel and a pink 'Confirm change' button over the dimmed plan cards. The gray translucent scrim turns the teal band murky. It stops at the viewport height, which is a full-page capture artifact of a fixed layer.

The dark dialog panel has a light border, a light hard shadow, an outlined Cancel and a pink Confirm. It is readable over the dimmed cards and invoice table. The translucent scrim again dims the band to a dark green.

The dialog sits mid-screen at nearly full width, with the title wrapped onto two lines and Cancel and Confirm sharing one row. Its hard shadow and ink border hold. The scrim covers only part of the full-page capture, a capture artifact of the fixed layer.

The change-password card shows a red summary box ('Fix the field marked below, then update again'), a green check with 'Strength: Strong' and 'Passwords do not match' with a warning icon under the confirm field. That field is focused, so it shows the halo instead of a red border. The pink update button sits in the save row and the sessions table has 2px Revoke actions.

In dark mode the confirm field shows a pink halo and the mismatch message sits under it. The red summary box at the top is legible. The sessions table below keeps its bordered box and outlined Revoke buttons.

One-column card with the wrapped error summary, the mismatch message under the halo-focused confirm field and a full-width pink update button. The sessions table scrolls inside its own bordered box, as the spec says, with no page scroll.

Keyboard focus is on the 'Security' sub-nav pill and shows as a clear 2px ink outline with an offset, following the pill's radius. The current 'Notifications' pill is filled ink. Below are outlined cards with pink 'On' switches labeled with words.

The focus ring on the 'Security' pill is a 2px pink outline with an offset, clearly visible on black. The current pill is paper-filled and the switches pair pink fills with On/Off words. The ink 'notifications on' count pill on the teal band is legible.

In the horizontal pill strip, 'Security' carries the offset focus outline next to the ink-filled current pill and is not clipped. The cards stack in one column with the switches and On/Off labels aligned on the right.

findings.summary: A field that is both invalid and focused loses its red error border to the pink focus halo, so while focused the field's error shows only in the message below it.
The save confirmation is a button-sized box with an ink border and hard shadow inside the action row, so it looks like a lifted button, not the bottom-left toast the spec describes.
The spec bans translucency but gives no rule for a modal backdrop, so the dialog uses a gray translucent scrim that turns the band color murky instead of a flat backdrop.
